title: Peruvian Vegan Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with Peruvian-inspired flavors, perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: Canned Tuna (replaced with Vegan alternative)
ingredients.notes: use a vegan tuna alternative like tofu or tempeh

instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
Heat the Peruvian-Style Hot Sauce in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cooked lima beans and stir to combine.
Add the chopped cilantro and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
In a separate bowl, mix together the vegan tuna alternative, lime juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
To assemble the bowl, place a scoop of cooked quinoa at the bottom, followed by the lima bean mixture, and finally the vegan tuna mixture.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
